single_output_policy.rule: One page must have one target Stitch screen, one final HTML, and one final screenshot in the formal output directory.
single_output_policy.generation: Use one accurate generate_screen_from_text prompt per page. Record detail issues first. Use edit_screens only once on the same screen for blocking external-delivery defects.
single_output_policy.detail_issue_policy: Non-blocking details such as spacing, icon preference, visual polish, motion nuance, and later asset replacement are logged in QA/issue-log instead of triggering repeated Stitch generations.
hard_issue_criteria: incorrect casing for protected product terms
